name: Love At First Latte!
source:
Love at First Latte! is a Yuri/GL visual novel about a burnt out office lady who finds herself inexplicably drawn towards the cool mysterious barista at the coffee shop across the street. Witness their relationship blossom, and learn about this brooding barista's hidden past in this short-yet-sweet kinetic visual novel.

[From [url=https://porksbun.itch.io/love-at-first-latte]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
第一杯拿铁就爱上了！是Yuri/GL的一部视觉小说，讲述了一位精疲力尽的办公室女士发现自己莫名其妙地被街对面咖啡店里的酷炫神秘咖啡师所吸引。在这部短小而甜蜜的动态视觉小说中，见证他们的关系蓬勃发展，并了解这位沉思的咖啡师隐藏的过去。

[来自[url=https://porksbun.itch.io/love-at-first-latte]itch.io[/url]]
